name: zh-expression-reviewer
description: Pre-publish review for Chinese text and UI: three-level AI-tell removal with zero fact loss, quantified thresholds, and automated scanning of the three hard UI fingerprints.

displayDescription.en: Pre-publish review for Chinese text and interfaces: three-level AI-tell removal with zero fact loss, quantified self-check thresholds, and automated scanning of the three hard UI fingerprints.
displayDescription.zh: 给中文文本和界面做发布前审校：三档强度去 AI 味、量化判据自查、界面三类硬指纹扫描，事实零损失。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这篇稿子读起来像 AI 写的，帮我按 L2 强度改一遍，不许加原文没有的事实。
defaultInitPrompt.en: This draft reads machine-written. Tighten it at L2 without adding any fact that is not in the original.

quickPrompts.en: This draft reads machine-written. Tighten it at L2 without adding any fact that is not in the original.
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇稿子读起来像 AI 写的，帮我按 L2 强度改一遍，不许加原文没有的事实。

quickPrompts.en: This landing page looks AI-generated. Scan it and give me a fix plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个落地页的配色和图标看着很 AI，帮我扫一遍并给修复方案。

quickPrompts.en: Run a pre-publish check and tell me: can this ship, and what is still missing?
quickPrompts.zh: 发布前帮我做一次自查，出结论：能不能发、还差什么。
